about.detail: By focusing strictly on product chemistry and wholesale supply, we ensure commercial buyers receive reliable stock, authentic LifeLines packaging, and verified chemical specifications.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Answers regarding our commercial product inventory, container sizes, and B2B ordering procedures.

items.question: What products does AutoUp supply?
items.answer: AutoUp supplies commercial automotive cleaning products including concentrated car shampoos (Colour Wax Shampoo, Pre-Wash), all-purpose degreasers (ChemX C2), finishing waxes (F55), dashboard conditioners (ChemX D2), tire dressings (ChemX T1, O2 Solvent), and streak-free glass polish (G4).

items.question: Does AutoUp provide consumer car washing or vehicle detailing services?
items.answer: No. AutoUp is strictly a B2B product supplier. We do not provide car washing, detailing, vehicle polishing, or in-person cleaning services to individual retail consumers.

items.question: What container sizes are available for business purchasing?
items.answer: Our products are supplied in heavy-duty commercial packaging: 20-litre liquid containers, 25-litre chemical drums, and 20-kilogram containers for pre-wash concentrates and polishes.

items.question: How can businesses request wholesale pricing?
items.answer: You can build an inquiry list on our website and click 'Request a Wholesale Quote', or message our team directly on WhatsApp. We provide itemized wholesale quotations based on your required products and order volume.

items.question: What are the dilution recommendations for car wash operations?
items.answer: Each product features specific dilution guidelines printed on the packaging. For example, our Colour Wax Shampoo dilutes at 1 litre to 100 litres of water for manual washing and 1:150 for pump systems, delivering cost-effective operational economics.

items.question: Are product prices shown on the website?
items.answer: Because AutoUp is a B2B supplier, wholesale pricing is customized based on order volumes and delivery locations. Pricing is verified directly through our quotation and WhatsApp inquiry flow.
